summary: Controller20 upgrade: four distinct HUD-visible before19/after20 BTC testnet USD100 and USD1000 fee pairs, one per comment and size. Current-source hook notionals, exact quote rates and UI sizing formula asserted. Ten fixtures checked on both networks: no positive discount. No submission; testnet positions empty. Historical17-to19 proof retained.

before_after_pairs.label: BTC $1,000 market preview fee: controller 17.1.0 before / 19.0.0 after
before_after_pairs.note: Same dev1 address, testnet, long, USD 1000, 3x. Both fee rows show $1.43. No active fee discount. Current trace records isFallback=false and unchanged controller rates. Close-all N/A because positions are empty. No order or close submitted.

before_after_pairs.label: Comment 1: BTC USD 100, controller 19 before / controller 20 after, HUD shown
